Name: Rehob in Asher
ModernLocation: Unknown; possibly Tell Bir el Gharbi, in Asher's allotment
Description: A Levitical town of Asher, named in Asher's allotment and again among the towns given to the Gershonite Levites; distinct from the Rehob of Beth-rehob in the north.
BiblicalSignificance: Rehob in Asher was set apart as a Levites' town within Asher's inheritance.
